note: Sky-blue counting room with a chequered floor (cartoon style). Landmark: the giant wooden abacus on the back wall (zoom: the abacus counting corner holds 0 and 11 to 19). Numbers in counting order: back row left to right 2 3 4 5 6, front row 7 8 9 10 20. Vingt is a small blue delivery VAN (minivan shape, side door slid open) packed with twenty crates (4 rows of 5). The open door on the left goes out to the school yard; the lavender door on the right leads to the articles room. Numbers have no gender (divider null).
